$comment: Generated by scripts/build/design-tokens.sh from design/tokens.json -- do not edit; change the tokens and run it again.

cruiseAltitude.description: A cruising altitude on the cruise controls, the profile and the route box: FL and three figures of hundreds of feet, against FAA usage on purpose (docs/decisions/0009; the owner, 2026-10-27).

mapLevel.description: An altitude on the map's weather (AIRMETs, SIGMETs, PIREPs): FL and three figures, no dash (docs/decisions/0009; the owner, 2026-11-06).

altitude.description: Any other altitude, height or elevation: grouped feet, as the FAA writes them. An em dash for no figure, which is not zero.

altitudeRange.description: The altitudes a route flies, lowest to highest.

duration.description: A time aloft, a time left or an age: Intl.DurationFormat's narrow style (the owner, 2026-10-28).

navLogTime.description: A leg's time en route as a paper nav log writes it.

zulu.description: A UTC clock time as reports and flight plans give it.

heading.description: A course, heading, track or wind direction: three figures, whole degrees, north as 360 (FAA Order JO 7110.65, 2-4-17).

distance.description: Nautical miles to a tenth, as the planner sends them.

speed.description: An airspeed, a ground speed or a wind speed: whole knots.

fuel.description: Fuel in US gallons to a tenth.

windCorrection.description: A wind correction angle: plus to the right, a minus sign to the left.

variation.description: Magnetic variation as the sectional's isogonic lines write it (FAA-H-8083-25C, chapter 16).
